audit_metadata.auditor_role: Senior Biomedical Signal Processing Engineer & Safety-Critical Software Auditor

domains.confidence_calculation_rationale: Initial high confidence attenuated to MODERATE due to EV-PHY-HRV-RMSSD having validity_status=INVALID (ZERO_VARIABILITY artifact). Resting heart rate (72.0 bpm) is valid, but autonomic cardiac regulation cannot be assessed.

eligible_evidence_items.relevance: Resting mean heart rate within nominal limits (50-100 bpm).

excluded_evidence_items.exclusion_reason: HRVStatus.ZERO_VARIABILITY represents an algorithmic or signal artifact with constant RR intervals; invalid telemetry cannot support physiological health inference.

rules_evaluated.rule_name: Red-Line Trigger: Acute Severe Chest Pain Complaint

rules_evaluated.reason: Resting heart rate (72.0 bpm) does not exceed 160.0 bpm.
Resting heart rate (72.0 bpm) is not below 40.0 bpm.
Resting heart rate is not between 100 and 160 bpm.

domains.protective_factor_exclusion_reason: PROT-CARDIO-01 blocked because has_invalid_hrv=True (ZERO_VARIABILITY artifact). Nominal heart rate alone cannot form a protective factor when autonomic regulation telemetry is invalid.
limitations: Cardiac autonomic HRV evidence (RMSSD) is INVALID (ZERO_VARIABILITY artifact); autonomic regulation cannot be confirmed from HRV.

domains.confidence_calculation_rationale: High confidence maintained: RESP sensor quality score 0.9925 (VALID), resting respiration rate 15.0 breaths/min is within standard reference limits (10-20 breaths/min), and zero data degradation.

eligible_evidence_items.relevance: Resting respiratory rate within NASA-STD-3001 limits.

rules_evaluated.reason: Respiration rate does not exceed 26.0 breaths/min.

protective_factors.explanation: Resting respiration rate (15.0 breaths/min) verified nominal within standard reference limits.

domains.confidence_calculation_rationale: Undetermined confidence: zero observational telemetry, neuro-vestibular surveys, or EEG recordings provided.
limitations: No telemetry or subjective observations provided for NEUROLOGICAL (Neurological/cognitive assessment, EEG telemetry, or neuro-vestibular symptoms).

domains.confidence_calculation_rationale: Undetermined confidence: zero sleep telemetry, sleep logs (actual_sleep_hours), or actigraphy data provided.
limitations: No telemetry or subjective observations provided for SLEEP_AND_FATIGUE (Sleep duration telemetry/log (actual_sleep_hours), circadian markers, or actigraphy).

domains.confidence_calculation_rationale: Confidence capped at MODERATE: domain relies on peripheral EDA (sympathetic arousal) and an experimental laboratory ML classifier (WESAD); validated clinical psychiatric and cognitive test batteries are absent.

eligible_evidence_items.relevance: Skin conductance level (4.69 uS) indicates non-elevated sympathetic arousal.

excluded_evidence_items.exclusion_reason: WESAD is a non-clinical laboratory benchmark stress classifier; cannot be used as an independent clinical risk factor or protective factor.

domains.protective_factor_exclusion_reason: PROT-PSYCH-01 eliminated because experimental WESAD ML model cannot establish psychological resilience or absence of psychiatric distress.
limitations: Psychological assessment limited to peripheral autonomic electrodermal activity (EDA) and experimental laboratory ML benchmark; validated clinical psychiatric and cognitive testing is unavailable.

domains.confidence_calculation_rationale: Confidence attenuated to MODERATE due to: (1) sensor TEMP quality status is ACCEPTABLE_WITH_WARNING (DEGRADED, 0.8500), and (2) measurement is peripheral skin surface temperature (34.27 °C), not core internal body temperature.

eligible_evidence_items.relevance: Peripheral skin surface temperature recorded at 34.27 °C.

rules_evaluated.reason: Core body temperature measurement unavailable; peripheral skin surface temperature cannot be evaluated against core hyperthermia thresholds without validated conversion model.

domains.protective_factor_exclusion_reason: PROT-THERM-01 eliminated because skin surface temperature cannot verify core body thermal homeostasis.
limitations: Thermoregulatory telemetry reflects peripheral skin surface temperature (34.27 °C) with ACCEPTABLE_WITH_WARNING quality; core body temperature is not directly monitored.

domains.confidence_calculation_rationale: Undetermined confidence: zero fluid intake/output logs, mass tracking, or hydration biomarkers provided.
limitations: No telemetry or subjective observations provided for HYDRATION_AND_FLUID_BALANCE (Fluid intake/output logs, continuous body mass tracking, or hydration biomarkers).

domains.confidence_calculation_rationale: Undetermined confidence: zero electromyography (EMG), exercise logs, or musculoskeletal complaint telemetry provided.
limitations: No telemetry or subjective observations provided for MUSCULOSKELETAL (Electromyography (EMG), daily exercise logs, or musculoskeletal complaint telemetry).

domains.confidence_calculation_rationale: Undetermined confidence: zero eligible observational evidence or confirmed symptom assessments submitted. Missing symptoms are treated as UNKNOWN symptom status, not negative findings.

excluded_evidence_items.exclusion_reason: Absence of a submitted symptom report does not establish clinical absence of symptoms or disease; excluded from positive risk classification.

domains.protective_factor_exclusion_reason: PROT-SYM-DENIAL-01 blocked because symptoms were unsubmitted, not explicitly denied during structured review.
limitations: No eligible observational evidence or confirmed symptom reports submitted. Unsubmitted symptoms represent unknown symptom status.

domains.confidence_calculation_rationale: Confidence attenuated to MODERATE because 1 of 6 active sensor channels (TEMP) is DEGRADED / ACCEPTABLE_WITH_WARNING (score: 0.8500).

rules_evaluated.reason: ECG sensor telemetry is not classified as INVALID.

domains.protective_factor_exclusion_reason: PROT-DATA-QUALITY-01 blocked because not all sensor channels are VALID (TEMP is ACCEPTABLE_WITH_WARNING / DEGRADED).
